Two women, a South American construction worker and an African American construction worker, were in the line to check out in the grocery store. The South American construction worker used a SNAP card to pay for her groceries, while the other woman pulled out black Amex card. Which person receives government benefits?
A. The African American construction worker
B. Not enough info
C. The South American construction worker
